solution: A GPU can process many similar image operations in parallel, improving throughput. RAM holds frames, model data and intermediate results; larger frames/more objects increase working data. Powerful hardware costs energy and money, while insufficient throughput increases delay and stale decisions. Choose enough GPU/RAM for measured frame-rate and latency requirements rather than assuming a simple box overlay means the whole detection task is cheap.
